text: CALL TO ORDER: 9:45 a.m. Speaker Nunziata took the Chair and called the Members to order. The meeting opened with O Canada. April 22, 2026 Members of Council observed a moment of silence in memory of: Clyde Henderson Clarke Sophie Constantopoulos Stephen Lewis Medhat Mahdy Barry Edmond McDermott Charlie Searle Marilyn Morrison, and Charlie Silson Speaker Nunziata addressed Council as follows: I would like to take a moment on behalf of Council to acknowledge the Indigenous Peoples of all the lands that we are on today. We do this to reaffirm our commitment and responsibility in improving relationships between nations and to deepening our own understanding of Indigenous peoples and their cultures.
